protocol.note: with LOAD high, DATA is clocked in on each CLK falling edge (CLK low between bytes, Figures 3-4 -> mode 1); LOAD pulsed low transfers the last 12 bits (address, RNG, D7-D0) to the selected DAC input latch: LOAD is an active-high frame pin and the command is decoded from the last 12 bits before LOAD falls (16-clock two-byte transfers with leading don't-care bits, Figures 3-4)

ldac.note: LDAC low: the selected DAC output updates when LOAD falls; LDAC high: the value is held until LDAC is pulsed low (p.3)
